e.title: insurance-recourse
e.summary: 算法救济（burning-cost）：FCA Consumer Duty 合规的保费降价建议——保险约束 + 保费单位输出 + 审计报告
e.summary_en: Algorithmic recourse (burning-cost): FCA Consumer Duty premium-lowering suggestions — insurance constraints, premium-denominated output, audit reports
e.summary_hk: 算法救濟（burning-cost）：FCA Consumer Duty 合規的保費降價建議——保險約束 + 保費單位輸出 + 審計報告
e.body: insurance-recourse（burning-cost）做 FCA Consumer Duty（PS22/9）合规的算法救济：回答「我怎么做才能降低保费」——保险原生约束（年龄/索赔史不可改、里程只能降、停车只能改善）、因果结构（改邮编同时改变治安/犯罪/洪水风险）、保费单位输出（£250 装防盗器）、审计报告（保单 ID/模型版本/SHA-256）。对 RIAA：监管透明度的前沿——Consumer Duty 要求向客户解释定价与改进途径；对比通用工具（DiCE/alibi）在抽象特征空间生成反事实、本包是保险定制的；与 [[insurance-fairness]]、[[insurance-governance]] 配套；消费者权益视角的精算应用。
e.body_en: insurance-recourse (burning-cost) does FCA Consumer Duty (PS22/9)-compliant algorithmic recourse: answering 'what can I change to lower my premium' — insurance-native constraints (age/claims history immutable, mileage only decreases, garaging only improves), causal structure (changing postcode changes crime/flood risk jointly), premium-denominated output (£250 immobiliser), audit reports (policyholder ID/model version/SHA-256). For RIAA: the frontier of regulatory transparency — Consumer Duty requires explaining pricing and improvement paths to customers; where generic tools (DiCE/alibi) generate counterfactuals in abstract feature space, this is insurance-customised; pairs with [[insurance-fairness]] and [[insurance-governance]]; actuarial application from the consumer-rights perspective.
e.body_hk: insurance-recourse（burning-cost）做 FCA Consumer Duty（PS22/9）合規的算法救濟：回答「我怎麼做才能降低保費」——保險原生約束（年齡/索賠史不可改、里程只能降、停車只能改善）、因果結構（改郵編同時改變治安/犯罪/洪水風險）、保費單位輸出（£250 裝防盜器）、審計報告（保單 ID/模型版本/SHA-256）。對 RIAA：監管透明度的前沿——Consumer Duty 要求向客戶解釋定價與改進途徑；對比通用工具（DiCE/alibi）在抽象特徵空間生成反事實、本包是保險定制的；與 [[insurance-fairness]]、[[insurance-governance]] 配套；消費者權益視角的精算應用。
